note: The one code table of the flight recorder (schema mml-recorder/1). XEXPL-01's explanation layers will read the same table. A code the recorder is given that is not listed here is counted in unknown_codes (the recorder test requires zero) and still written as given. 'not evaluated' is the value stored for anything the engine did not compute; nothing is invented.

entity_kinds.p: person: p:<permanent person id> (ID-01); the current player character is p:<PlayerState.pid>, marked by the participant role suffix :player, never a separate identity; p:player only if a player has no pid (a bare test world)
entity_kinds.role: an office that passes from person to person: role:player is held by one person at a time (changes at succession)
entity_kinds.inv: an inventory whose owner the recorder could not name
entity_kinds.tie: a pair's relationship, tie:<lower id>:<higher id> (Relations.key; a player tie uses their person id, -2 the host)
entity_kinds.clan: B25R1: a bandit clan, clan:<id> (the village camp's band is clan:bandit, NPC.clan's value; an outlaw community has its own id)
entity_kinds.homestead: B25R1: a wilderness settlement (lawful or outlaw), homestead:<claim id> (Homesteads); the same ref through affiliation changes
entity_kinds.settlement: an off-map settlement, settlement:<id> (Regions); also the place of a journey
entity_kinds.landmark: B25R1-003: a discoverable place, landmark:<Landmarks id>
entity_kinds.cell: B25R1-011: an open-country cell, cell:<x>,<y> (village coordinates)
entity_kinds.journey: REGION-NAV-01 / B25R1-009: one traveller's journey, journey:<person id>:<start day>.<start minute>
entity_kinds.village: the village as a place (origin or destination)
entity_kinds.wild: B25R1: open country with no settlement, wild:<x>,<y>

alert_rules.coin.unattributed_holder: a holder's coins changed by an amount no recorded coin state change explains
alert_rules.economy.unbacked_reservation: X20-FINAL: the LE-01 model holds a reservation no stock backs (EconReservations.unbacked; only when economy.json is on)
alert_rules.identity.ids_changed_on_load: a version 20 save was loaded and the set of person ids differs from the saved register
alert_rules.coin.unattributed_total: World.total_coins changed by an amount neither the recorded coin changes nor World.coin_sources explain

reasons.not_feasible: the live decision code marked the candidate infeasible (its own words are the factor row why)
reasons.invalid_trade: quantity or price not valid, or buyer and seller the same
reasons.buyer_short_of_coins: the buyer's purse was below the bill
reasons.seller_lacks_item: the seller did not hold the units
reasons.buyer_inventory_full: the buyer could not take the item
reasons.from_lacks_item: the giving inventory did not hold the units
reasons.to_cannot_take: the receiving inventory could not take the item
reasons.act_returned_false: the action returned false; the code gives no finer reason
reasons.no_path: the path search found no route
reasons.no_level_route: no portal leads to the step's level
reasons.station_wait_exceeded: waited the station wait limit for the player to finish at a station
reasons.guard_or_planner_declined: the branch's guard was false or its planner returned no plan; the chain does not say which
reasons.treasury_short: the manor's treasury could not pay
reasons.refused_by_rules: the action's own rules refused it (the reason is in the detail)
reasons.too_far: the player was out of reach
reasons.pack_full: the player's pack could not take the item
reasons.nothing_to_take: the container held nothing to pick
reasons.recognised: the buyer recognised the goods as their own stolen property
reasons.questioned: a guard questioned the player about stolen goods
reasons.sale_failed: the sale did not go through
reasons.buy_failed: the purchase did not go through
reasons.craft_refused: the craft could not be done
reasons.target_gone: fight(): the target died, left the level, or (an NPC target) went into another building
reasons.bandit_low_hp: fight(): a bandit below 30% health breaks off
reasons.bandit_retreat: fight(): a bandit weighing the danger (JudgmentBandit, X20-BANDIT-AI) falls back to the camp
reasons.out_of_range: fight(): the target was more than 25 tiles away
reasons.near_bandit_camp: fight(): a guard's target was within 12 tiles of the bandit camp
reasons.blocked: fight(): the straight-line chase step landed in a solid cell (SIM-F4): the chase is given up; the corner case of GP-CRIME-PURSUIT
reasons.robbed: fight(): a bandit robbed its victim and went back to the camp
reasons.target_slain: fight(): the fighter's blow killed the target
reasons.cleared_elsewhere: the target was cleared by other code (the player's death, a kill, a reset); seen at the next hour
reasons.retargeted: the fighter was given a different target before this chase ended
reasons.lost_sight: fight(): a guard on a player's case lost sight of them (A2): the search of the last-known place begins; the case stays open
reasons.case_closed: fight() or the search: the case ended (the offender died, yielded or was taken in; A2, A3)
reasons.searched: the search of the last-known place and around it found nothing in its time (A2): the case goes over to wanted
reasons.yielded: the offender yielded to the guards (A3): fined, the stolen goods returned
reasons.taken: a guard who may not kill beat the offender down and took them in (A3): fined, the stolen goods returned
reasons.not_reached: an earlier branch took the decision, so this branch (alternative option "after:<winner>" stands for every later branch of the chain) was not evaluated

life_transition: a meaningful life transition (trigger: came_of_age, partnered, widowed, child_born, household_crowded, housing_wait, job_lost, hardship_threshold, orphaned, evicted, raised_in_clan_adult, other)
household_formed: a new household exists (track young_adult, established_adult, couple, runaway, former_bandit; household the new one, origin the household left)
household_dissolved: a household ended (reason: all_died, merged, abandoned, left)
faction_changed: faction or legal standing changed (faction_before -> faction, legal_before -> legal); the same person, never a replacement
homestead_evaluated: existing judgment evaluated the opportunities (alternatives, chosen)
homestead_chosen: the NPC chose homesteading (an intention: never a completed homestead)
homestead_rejected: the NPC rejected homesteading (outcome refused; reason)
homestead_site_evaluated: a wilderness site was evaluated (candidates, score, chosen or none)
homestead_travel_begin: set out for the site (origin, destination)
homestead_travel_end: reached the site (ok) or did not (failed / abandoned, reason)
homestead_claimed: land claimed or occupied (place homestead:<id>): still not a completed homestead
homestead_resources: required resources obtained (items, coins, how: bought, felled, quarried, carried)
homestead_construction: shelter or infrastructure progress (what, done of need)
homestead_residence: actual residence established: the completed move
homestead_sustain: food, water, employment and household needs met (ok) or not (failed), once a day per homestead household
homestead_year: the household continued through another game year (8 days) at the homestead
homestead_family_change: a birth, partnership, member joining or leaving at a homestead
homestead_inheritance: the homestead passed to an heir
homestead_abandoned: the household gave the homestead up (reason; where they went)
runaway_hardship: household hardship reached a threshold (needs: hunger, food_days, purse, hardship_days; family circumstances)
runaway_evaluated: the young person weighed staying or going (alternatives: stay_home, seek_help, find_work, relocate, survive_alone, approach_outlaws)
runaway_outcome: what actually happened (action: sheltered, employed, relocated, independent, joined_outlaws, returned, died)
recruit_circumstance: the circumstances that lead toward outlaw life (source: orphan, runaway, displaced_adult, fugitive, voluntary, relationship, raised_in_clan, arrival)
recruit_sought: the decision to seek outlaw life (alternatives, chosen)
recruit_contact: travelled to or met a clan (place clan:<id>)
recruit_rejected: the clan rejected the recruit (outcome refused; reason)
recruit_joined: actual membership and residence changed (faction_before -> faction; counts in the bandit ledger)
outlaw_occupation: an outlaw took up or trained in an occupation (action, skill)
clan_birth: a child born into a clan (counts in the bandit ledger as a birth)
clan_member_died: a clan member died (cause; counts in the bandit ledger as a death)
bandit_leave_evaluated: an adult bandit weighed leaving outlaw life (alternatives, chosen)
bandit_departed: membership ended (retained items, coins, skills, crimes in needs/factors; counts in the bandit ledger as a departure)
bandit_reintegrated: a former bandit established lawful life (action: new_household, occupation, lawful_homestead, married)
settlement_created: a wilderness settlement exists (path lawful or outlaw)
settlement_construction: a building or work at a settlement progressed or finished
settlement_occupancy: a resident moved in or out (action in / out)
settlement_affiliation: the settlement's ownership or affiliation changed (the same buildings and residents)
settlement_discovered: a hidden settlement was found (by the player or an NPC)
settlement_state: one a day per wilderness settlement: population, households, food_units, water, stores, coins, livestock, path (written by WorldRecorder from Homesteads.recorder_rows)
wild_production: goods made outside the village (action: farm, livestock, hunt, gather, fell, quarry, mine, craft, water, fish; items)
wild_consumption: goods used outside the village (action: eat, drink, fuel, build, feed)
wild_trade: a purchase or sale by a wilderness household (counterparty; the World.trade event is its own record)
wild_shortage: food or water short at a wilderness household (needs)
sale_refused: a legitimate resource sale refused (reason: no_demand, counter_full, no_buyer, price)
livestock_change: livestock born, died, bought, sold, stolen or slaughtered (action)
skill_progress: a skill rose through actual work (summary: skill:<id> before -> after)
wild_craft: inputs made into finished goods (items: inputs negative, outputs positive)
raid: a raid on a settlement, homestead or traveller (outcome ok / failed / refused; goods and coins taken)
raid_defended: defenders met a raid (outcome ok: repelled)
journey_begin: a traveller set out (origin, destination, action: buy, sell, envoy, visit, seed; object journey:<id>)
journey_leg: a leg of a journey done (place)
journey_purchase: bought or sold on a journey (items, coins)
journey_end: the journey ended (outcome ok: home again; failed / abandoned; reason: died, lost, no_route, refused)
travel_destination_set: the player chose a destination on the Region map (route length, road share)
travel_refused: a destination could not be reached (reason)
road_formed: footfall raised a cell's level (summary level before -> after: grass, trail, dirt road)
road_cleared: a step cleared a grown-over road
road_wear: stone damage passed a state (look stone -> stone_damaged -> stone_broken)
road_faded: one a dawn: worn paths that lost a level without footfall (cells)
road_overgrown: one a dawn: walked roads that turned grown over (cells)
road_paved: a cell paved with stone (by, stone used, labour)
road_repaired: a damaged stone cell repaired (by, stone used)
roads_day: one a dawn: cells of the road network and worn-in cells by look
landmark_discovered: the player found a place on foot (place landmark:<id>, kind)
clan_census: one a dawn per clan: members (role bandit), dependants (clan children); the bandit ledger's check (written by WorldRecorder)
population_day: one a dawn: the village by life stage, occupations, households, bandits and clan dependants, wilderness and off-map populations (written by WorldRecorder)
homestead_safeguard: the young-adult safeguard refused a homestead (needs: formations, the eligible denominator, and homesteads so far)
homestead_trip: a homesteader's market trip (needs: pantry_days, coins)
homestead_failed: the household gave up before or after building (reason; who returned)
journey_refused: a journey could not start (reason: no_road)
journey_provisioned: food for the road taken from the household's pantry (needs: food_points)
journey_errand_failed: the journey's errand failed at the destination (reason)
journey_waited: the traveller waited at the destination for goods (needs: mornings_left)
journey_designated: a resident designated as a seed traveller (SeedTravelers: item, seller, destination)
well_built: a well dug (place; materials and labour)
water_drawn: water drawn from a well or a stream (needs: units)
band_relocated: the band moved its home (origin, destination: a concealed claim)
band_migrated_on_load: an older save's band moved to its overworld claim on load (the same people)
unmapped_event: a system's event the recorder has no mapping for (detail: its kind; needs: its data): listed in the exception report
water_source_selected: a settlement or homestead chose its water (source stream or well, cell, distance; availability in needs)
water_unavailable: a settlement's water source could not be used (dry, frozen, too far, blocked; reason)
settlement_attempt_failed: a settlement attempt failed before a claim (reason: no_water, terrain, resources)
bridge_built: a bridge built over water (cell, by, materials)
bridge_used: a traveller crossed a bridge (cell; the journey's object)
route_crossing: a route was planned across water (chosen: bridge, ford, detour; alternatives with lengths)
travel_blocked_by_water: a journey or route failed because of water (outcome failed; reason no_crossing, flooded)

chronicle_fields.who: the person: an NPC, a PlayerState, a person id (int) or a ref string; null for world
chronicle_fields.place: settlement or wilderness location ref (event.settlement column)
chronicle_fields.faction: village, outlaw, settlement:<id>, clan:<id>, homestead:<id>, wild
chronicle_fields.track: young_adult, established_adult, runaway, former_bandit, outlaw, player (homestead and household formation)
chronicle_fields.path: lawful or outlaw (a settlement's or a homestead's)
chronicle_fields.outcome: ok, failed, refused, abandoned, interrupted, partial (default ok)
chronicle_fields.needs: {name: value} needs and economic circumstances (factor rows, option needs)
chronicle_fields.factors: {name: value} judgment factors (factor rows, option judgment)
chronicle_fields.alternatives: [[option, feasible, score, reason], ...] (alternative rows; with chosen a decision row kind life_choice)
chronicle_fields.coins: [[ref, before, after], ...] coin moves NOT recorded by any other hook (authority wilds.coins: the hourly audit counts them)
chronicle_fields.items: [[ref, item, before, after], ...] item moves NOT recorded by any other hook (authority wilds.items)
chronicle_fields.summary: [[ref, prop, before, after], ...] values already moved elsewhere, restated (authority summary: never counted twice)
chronicle_fields.related: {role: ref or [refs]} related NPCs, households, settlements, clans
chronicle_fields.object: object thread key (homestead:<id>, journey:<id>, clan:<id>, cell:<x>,<y>): links the events of one thing
chronicle_fields.parent: an event id to hang this one under
